result:
The app shell now publishes the Module Federation runtime once on a global, and each remote reads it from there instead of bundling its own copy. This shipped as O3-5873, in PR #1853 (commit `04f538d`).

**Why the duplication was a problem.** Every remote entry embedded its own copy of `@module-federation/runtime-core`, which made up roughly two thirds of each entry's size. The runtime is identical across modules, so a page that loaded several apps downloaded the same code once per app. The changeset measures this on `@openmrs/esm-login-app`: a production remote entry dropped from about 85 kB to 32 kB raw (about 26 kB to 9.7 kB gzipped). About 14 kB of runtime still stays in each remote (`openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/mf-runtime-shipped-once.md`, lines 10-14).

**What the app shell does now.**
- The rspack build of the shell sets `experiments.provideExternalRuntime: true`, which publishes `runtime-core` as `_FEDERATION_RUNTIME_CORE` for remotes to read. Module Federation only allows this on a build with no `exposes`. It also sets `optimization: { target: 'web' }`, since every app shares this one runtime (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/shell/esm-app-shell/rspack.config.js`, lines 489-502).
- `publishFederationRuntime()` in `federation-runtime.ts` also publishes the stateless `error-codes` and `sdk` helpers as globals. It logs an error if the runtime is missing, so a broken shell says so itself rather than every app blaming an old shell. `index.ts` calls it first, before anything else loads.
- The `@openmrs/rspack-config` and `@openmrs/webpack-config` remote builds read the runtime from these globals. They refuse to start under an app shell that doesn't provide it.

**Which change and ticket.** PR #1853, "(feat) Federate most of the Module Federation runtime", merged as `04f538d`. The changeset names ticket O3-5873. Provenance links the ticket to PR #1853 through a ticket pattern, not through the commit subject, which carries no ticket key.

**Caveats.**
- This is a breaking change. Apps built with the new tooling need an app shell of this version or newer, so the shell must be deployed first. Older apps still run in the new shell, but not the reverse (`openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/wacky-pens-refuse.md`, line 7 and surrounding text).
- Webpack-built remotes get larger (about 8.7 kB to 23 kB raw), because they previously shipped no runtime at all.
- `@module-federation/runtime` and `webpack-bundler-runtime` are deliberately not published, because they cache federation state at module scope.
